name: uol-mcp
description: Ask about your UOL Účetnictví bookkeeping: invoices, receivables, VAT, revenue and expenses, documents.
long_description: Unofficial connector for the UOL Účetnictví REST API, not affiliated with UOL a.s. Read-only by default: issued and received invoices, who owes you money, VAT per filing period, revenue and expenses from the general ledger, bank balances, uploaded documents and contacts. With access=write it can also upload documents and create or edit draft invoices. Uses your own UOL API token; data goes to the model Claude uses.

tenant.title: UOL tenant
tenant.description: First part of your UOL address (https://firma.ucetnictvi.uol.cz → firma), or "demo" for UOL's public DEMO company.

email.title: E-mail
email.description: E-mail you log into UOL with. Not needed for demo.

token.title: API token
token.description: Create it on your tenant at /api_tokens; the user needs the REST API permission. Not needed for demo.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Where exported invoices and downloaded documents are saved. Default: Downloads/uol-mcp.

access.title: Access
access.description: read (default) — the assistant can only read. write — it may also upload documents, create or edit draft invoices, contacts and payment demands; Claude asks before each write. full — also deleting drafts and cancelling issued invoices.

toolsets.title: Tool groups
toolsets.description: core,insights (default). Add ledger, banking or warehouse, or use all.
